products.title: Head Pro Player Cap Black - Caps
products.description:
The HEAD PRO PLAYER CAP has a very attractive design with the best materials, marking an elegant style typical of HEAD throughout its padel range.
 The HEAD PRO PLAYER CAP is released in 4 colors, black, white, navy blue and turquoise. In both light and dark colors it has a sober appearance and with a detail near the brand's visor that does not stand out too much.

Regarding its composition we can see a visor of adequate length to protect from the discomfort of the sun while playing outdoors. Inside we see a padded area in the forehead area to significantly reduce the amount of sweat that can reach our eyes. In the back area we have a thinner fabric with microperforations generating greater comfort and ventilation for those moments of maximum heat. Finally, we find an adjustment with velcro and a gap for greater breathing and placement of the ponytail if necessary.

products.title: Asics Sonicsmash Ff Saba Blue Vital Green 2026 40 - Asics
products.description:
ASICS SONICSMASH FF SABA BLUE VITAL GREEN 2026 - Professional padel shoes. New model for the 2026 season, with a radical design. The ASICS SONICSMASH FF SABA BLUE VITAL GREEN 2026 Designed for fast, explosive padel players with an offensive playing style, these shoes combine lightness, cushioning and stability in every movement. This new SONIC series is going to give a lot to talk about, positioning itself as one of the most complete high-end shoes in the sector.

Its FlyteFoam technology in the midsole provides a soft and reactive step, absorbing impact without adding extra weight, ideal for those who need agility when moving.

Thanks to the X-Groove design sole, flexibility is optimized and a greater range of motion is allowed, facilitating quick turns and natural transitions in any direction.

They also incorporate SpeedTruss technology in the midfoot area, providing extra structural support and greater stability when starting, braking and sudden changes of direction.

products.title: Asics Sonicsmash Ff White Steel Grey 45 - Asics
products.description:
ASICS SONICSMASH FF WHITE STEEL GRAY - Guaranteed increase in your speed on the track with the new Sonicsmash. A light shoe, and now renewed with a very elegant white and gray design that can be combined with practically everything. INTRODUCTION OF THE SNEAKERS

The new ASICS SONICSMASH FF WHITE STEEL GRAY now available at Pádel Ibérico. This model maintains the agile and dynamic character of the Sonicsmash FF, but this time they arrive with a much cleaner and more discreet white and steel gray combination. We find them to be especially attractive sneakers for those looking for a modern model that is also easy to combine.

PLAYER TYPE

They are perfectly suitable for all player profiles, but let's be honest, they are high-end padel shoes, so if we are an advanced player who plays several days a week and wants high performance and comfort, these are some of the best padel shoes on the market.

MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRUCTION DATA

Instead of opting for a particularly rigid construction, ASICS has sought to ensure that the Sonicsmash FF follows the movement of the foot. The FLYTEFOAM midsole has a lot to do with this: it cushions the supports well, quickly recovers its shape and maintains a contained weight.

The sole of these shoes is clay, so grip is more than assured.

products.title: Softee Swat Yellow - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE SWAT YELLOW - Ideal padel racket to improve and make the jump to a better racket if you come from an entry-level model.
*Aesthetic defect
 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

With the SOFTEE SWAT YELLOW you will be able to focus your game towards a little more power. It is an intermediate range padel racket, which will help you continue progressing in your game.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this model for a medium level player, who plays regularly and wants to make the step up to a slightly more powerful racket.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features of the SOFTEE SWAT YELLOW are very good considering that this is a very, very cheap racket for everything it offers us.

This model has a hybrid teardrop format, which achieves intermediate balance and therefore a more versatile and balanced game. It has an enlarged sweet spot.

The main material of this racket is fiberglass and eva soft s3 rubber.

products.title: Wilson Active Perforated Cap Red - Caps
products.description:
WILSON ACTIVE PERFORATED CAP - Get the Wilson active perforated padel cap. Designed for competitive players looking for the best quality and high protection from the sun. The WILSON ACTIVE PERFORATED CAP has been manufactured with quick-drying technical materials, with the main objective of keeping sweat under control and protecting from the sun without being overwhelming. Its curved visor offers effective shade without interfering with vision. 

Its light and flexible structure adapts comfortably to the head, while the side perforations allow constant ventilation even on the hottest days.

Recommended for a padel player who wants to be elegant and not lose points in their most important matches for the typical excuse of the sun.
